name: Painted Gnoll Armband
summary: At Westbrook Garrison, Painted Gnoll Armbands prove that Riverpaw gnolls have been slain. The marked bands come from packs pressing against Elwynn Forest's western border.

sections.title: Tokens of the Riverpaw
sections.body: Riverpaw warriors and scavengers wear rough armbands painted with crude tribal patterns. The bands come from gnolls along Elwynn Forest's wilderness borders. For Stormwind's defenders, the packs pose a growing threat near Stone Cairn Lake and in the woods south of Westbrook Garrison.

sections.title: Bounty for Westbrook Garrison
sections.body: Stormwind's Army is stretched thin across the kingdom, leaving Westbrook Garrison hard pressed to secure the western border. Deputy Rainer offers a standing bounty for slaying Riverpaw outrunners and runts. Their painted armbands prove the kills, helping the deputies count the bounties and thin the packs near nearby farmlands.

faq.q: Why does Westbrook Garrison want these armbands?
faq.answer: Deputy Rainer at Westbrook Garrison collects the armbands as proof that Riverpaw gnolls have been slain. Garrison troops cannot manage the encroaching packs alone, so Stormwind pays bounties to adventurers who bring back the tokens.

faq.q: Which gnolls wear these painted armbands?
faq.answer: Riverpaw gnolls wear the painted armbands. Riverpaw Outrunners and Riverpaw Runts infest the woods south of Westbrook Garrison and the shores around Stone Cairn Lake.

faq.q: Why are Riverpaw gnolls in Elwynn Forest?
faq.answer: Riverpaw packs have pushed east along Elwynn Forest's borders, setting up camps near Stone Cairn Lake and the forest margins. With the kingdom's military presence depleted, they hunt, scavenge, and threaten nearby settlements.

faq.q: What is the significance of the paint on the armbands?
faq.answer: The paint marks trophies taken from Riverpaw gnolls and helps prove the kills to Deputy Rainer. The patterns have no stated rank or meaning.

angles.text: As an Alliance adventurer, collecting these armbands helps Westbrook Garrison hold Stormwind's western frontier while the city's standing army is diverted elsewhere.
